summary.en: Let Floatboat route each task to a suitable model and fall back when needed.
summary.zh: 让 Floatboat 为每项任务选择合适模型，并在需要时自动降级。

title.en: AI Model Router and Automatic Model Selection | Floatboat Auto Mode
title.zh: AI 模型自动路由与智能选择｜Floatboat 畅用模式

description.en: Learn how an AI model router selects models by task complexity, context, modality, speed, and availability, with automatic fallback when a route is unavailable.
description.zh: 了解 AI 模型自动路由如何根据任务复杂度、上下文、输入模态、速度与可用性选择模型，并在路径不可用时自动降级。

title.en: Auto / Lite Mode: let the workspace route the task.
title.zh: Auto / Lite 模式：让工作空间为任务选择模型。

description.en: The model directory calls this Auto Mode; the user guide calls the automatic routing entry Lite mode. Choose the automatic option shown in your client, then switch models when the assignment needs it.
description.zh: 模型目录使用 Auto Mode 名称，用户指南将自动路由入口称为 Lite mode。以客户端实际显示的自动模式为准，再按任务需要切换模型。

value.zh: 任务、上下文、模态与可用性

title.en: A dispatcher that removes model management from the job.
title.zh: 把模型管理从任务中拿走的调度者。

description.en: Auto Mode is for people who want to describe the work once and let Floatboat decide how much reasoning, context, and speed it needs.
description.zh: 畅用模式适合只想说明工作、不想持续研究型号的人。Floatboat 会判断任务需要多少推理、上下文与响应速度。

value.zh: 无需额外配置即可调度

description.en: The request itself supplies the routing signal.
description.zh: 用户的任务描述本身就是调度依据。

description.en: Files, rules, and prior output stay with the project.
description.zh: 文件、规则与此前产出继续留在项目中。

description.en: A suitable fallback can keep work moving when a route is unavailable.
description.zh: 首选路径不可用时，可用合适的降级路径继续任务。

description.en: Switch to a fixed model when repeatability matters.
description.zh: 需要固定行为或可重复结果时，可改为手动选择。

title.en: Different work calls for different strengths.
title.zh: 不同任务，需要不同能力。

description.en: Reasoning depth, context length, media input, and response speed can point to different execution routes. This overview explains the task demands considered by Auto Mode rather than presenting routing as a preference for one permanent model.
description.zh: 推理深度、上下文长度、媒体输入和响应速度，可能对应不同执行路径。以下说明 Auto Mode 判断任务需求时关注的方向，帮助理解自动选择，而不是将路由视为固定偏好某个模型。

description.en: Planning, proofs, architecture, and difficult debugging.
description.zh: 规划、证明、架构设计与疑难调试。

description.en: Repositories, research collections, and long documents.
description.zh: 代码库、研究资料与长文档。

description.en: Screenshots, diagrams, images, and mixed inputs.
description.zh: 截图、图表、图像与混合输入。

description.en: Drafting, classification, and lightweight edits.
description.zh: 起草、分类与轻量修改。

title.en: Use Cases for Auto / Lite Mode

description.zh: 任务从研究转向实施时，对执行路径的要求也会改变。自动模式需要维持项目连续性，入口中断后的回退结果同样应按原要求复核，清楚标明哪些步骤能够继续、哪些仍然受阻。
description.en: Research, implementation, and daily edits place different demands on an execution route. These scenarios examine continuity across changing requests and interruptions, with results checked against the same project constraints after a route changes.

A project may move from reading sources to choosing a design and implementing it. Keep the research, open decisions, and approved requirements in the same context as the work progresses. Check that implementation and verification still follow the original constraints and that conclusions remain linked to their sources.
description.zh: 一项项目工作可能先阅读资料，再决定设计方向，最后进入实施。推进过程中保留研究来源、待定问题与已批准的要求，避免不同环节各自重新解释任务。完成实施与验证后，仍应能够把结果对应回原有约束和研究结论。

description.en: A daily queue can mix summaries, local edits, and fault investigations. Treat each request according to its own requirements while retaining the project context needed by adjacent steps. Review the summary, diff, or diagnosis with the evidence appropriate to that task, rather than applying one acceptance rule to everything.
description.zh: 日常任务可能同时包含资料总结、本地修改和故障调查。根据每项工作的实际要求处理，并保留前后步骤需要的项目上下文。总结、代码差异和诊断结果分别使用适合自身的证据进行检查，避免用同一种标准判断所有任务。

description.en: An unavailable model route can interrupt a task before its work is complete. Retain the current state and continue through available system routes where possible, then recheck fallback results against the original requirements. Identify any steps that remain blocked instead of treating a changed route as proof of completion.
description.zh: 模型入口不可用时，保留未完成任务的当前状态，并在存在可用系统路径时继续推进。切换后重新检查结果是否满足原始要求，明确哪些步骤已经恢复、哪些仍然受阻。入口发生变化并不意味着任务已经完成，后续结果仍需核对。

title.en: Routing decisions that normally interrupt the work.
title.zh: 接管那些原本会打断工作的模型决策。

description.en: Automatic routing should adapt execution without replacing the project being worked on. Examine how task complexity, retained context, input modality, and fallback affect model selection while the original material and expected outcome remain the reference for review.
description.zh: 执行路径可以随复杂度、上下文或输入类型改变，项目背景不应因此断开。自动选择与回退需要继续对应原始资料和预期交付，路由变化后的结果也仍要接受同一任务要求的检查。

description.en: Distinguishes lightweight requests from work that deserves deeper reasoning.
description.zh: 区分轻量请求与真正需要深度推理的工作。

description.en: Accounts for repositories, document sets, and long-running conversations.
description.zh: 考虑代码库、资料集与长程对话所需的上下文。

description.en: Considers whether the task includes text, images, or mixed material.
description.zh: 根据文本、图像或混合材料选择合适路径。

description.en: Can move to a suitable alternative when the preferred route is unavailable.
description.zh: 首选路径不可用时可切换到合适替代方案。

title.en: Use Auto when the work changes shape.
title.zh: 当工作会不断变换形态时，使用畅用模式。

items.en: You want a reliable default without tracking every model release.
items.zh: 你需要可靠默认选项，不想追踪每次模型更新。

items.en: One project mixes research, reasoning, editing, and execution.
items.zh: 同一项目混合调研、推理、修改与执行。

items.en: Continuity matters more than fixing one model for every request.
items.zh: 任务连续性比固定使用同一模型更重要。

title.zh: 这些情况更适合手动选择

items.en: A repeatable workflow requires the same model behavior every time.
items.zh: 可重复工作流要求每次保持相同模型行为。

items.en: You are testing or comparing a specific model.
items.zh: 你正在测试或比较某个具体模型。

items.en: A task has a known requirement that only one listed route satisfies.
items.zh: 任务存在只有某个已列路径才能满足的明确要求。

title.en: How Auto Mode routes a request
title.zh: Auto Mode 如何为请求选择模型

description.en: Floatboat identifies the required depth, context, and modality.
description.zh: Floatboat 判断所需推理深度、上下文和模态。

description.en: It selects a suitable model and can fall back if that route is unavailable.
description.zh: 系统选择合适模型，并在路径不可用时自动降级。

description.en: Files, rules, and output remain attached to the same project.
description.zh: 文件、规则与输出继续留在同一项目中。

question.en: When should I use Auto Mode instead of choosing a model?
question.zh: 什么时候应该使用畅用模式，而不是手动选择模型？

answer.en: Use Auto Mode when the task matters more than maintaining a fixed model choice, especially when one project moves between research, reasoning, editing, and execution.
answer.zh: 当完成任务比固定模型更重要时使用畅用模式，尤其适合同一项目会在调研、推理、修改与执行之间切换的情况。

question.zh: 可以覆盖 Auto Mode 的选择吗？

answer.en: Yes. Select a model directly when repeatability or explicit control matters.
answer.zh: 可以。当可重复性或明确控制更重要时，可直接指定模型。

question.en: Does one request go to every provider?
question.zh: 一次请求会发给所有供应商吗？

answer.en: No. Auto Mode selects a route; it does not broadcast the request to every model.
answer.zh: 不会。Auto Mode 会选择一条路径，而不是向所有模型广播请求。

question.en: What happens when a route is unavailable?
question.zh: 首选路径不可用时怎么办？

answer.en: Auto Mode can choose a suitable fallback so the task can continue.
answer.zh: Auto Mode 可以选择合适的降级模型，让任务继续进行。

question.en: What signals does an AI model router use?
question.zh: AI 模型路由会参考哪些信号？

answer.en: Auto Mode evaluates task complexity, context size, input modality, response speed, and route availability before selecting a model.
answer.zh: 畅用模式会在选择模型前判断任务复杂度、上下文规模、输入模态、响应速度与路径可用性。

question.en: How can I compare Auto Mode with a fixed-model run fairly?
question.zh: 怎样公平比较自动模式与固定模型的结果？

answer.en: Use the same brief, files, tools, and acceptance checks, and record the routing information available in the client. Compare the accepted deliverables and revisions; two runs can differ even when the visible request is identical.
answer.zh: 使用同一任务说明、文件、工具和验收标准，并记录客户端可见的路由信息。比较最终可接受的成果和修改量；即使请求文字相同，两次执行也可能不同。

title.en: Route the next task without picking a model
title.zh: 下一项任务交给畅用模式自动选路

description.en: Start with the real brief and files. Auto Mode chooses among available models and falls back when needed, so you can review the result.
description.zh: 带上真实任务和文件开始，畅用模式会在可用模型之间调度，并在需要时自动降级；交付结果仍由你检查。
